name: delivery-dashboard
description: A run surface: the live dashboard where a run becomes visible. An MCP server implementing all three surface capability groups — lifecycle (open_dashboard, start_run, record_prompt, set_run_context, update_stage, finish_run, list_runs, get_run), render (render_diagram, render_markdown) and export (export_report) — plus a Mermaid diagram viewer and a Markdown document viewer, rendered inline as an MCP App or served on 127.0.0.1. Depends on nothing and knows nothing about what produces the runs it shows.
